title: New look for Character, Inventory and Skills
changes: One dark gothic frame for the three tabs, with big engraved tab names
Stats column: offense as four tiles (spell damage first), resistances as five coloured chips; hovering an item or skill still shows what changes
Character: your name with a level medal, attribute cards with a big + button and where each point comes from, and health, mana and experience bars
Inventory: gear sits around your hero by body part, full item names, frames glow in the item's rarity colour, and the item you point at shows in a card under the bag
Skills: the skill info stays in a bar under the tree
